content.short: MintWorld is a web3 based 2D Monster Catcher RPG with blockchain collectibles.
content.description: MintWorld is a fun and engaging web3-based 2D Monster Catcher RPG in which players can collect and trade unique blockchain-based monsters. The game features city-specific DAOs, inviting local communities to participate in governance, and it gives players a voice in shaping the game's story and core mechanics. By blending collection, trading, and player-driven storytelling, MintWorld creates a collaborative, evolving RPG where communities influence updates and the world they explore together.
